name: currency-collapse-video
description: Remotion video for The 2030 Currency Collapse

scripts.test: npm run test:custom-film && npm run test:motion-library
scripts.test:motion-library: npm run generate:motion-audio && rm -rf .motion-test-build && tsc -p tsconfig.motion-test.json && node --test tests/motion-library.test.cjs
scripts.render:motion-preview: npm run generate:motion-audio && remotion render MotionLibraryPreview out/motion-library-preview.mp4 --concurrency=1
